adrs.title: The connector caller token names the run and work item
adrs.summary: partial

adrs.title: A settled approval card is a record of the decision, and the requester thread reads in order
adrs.summary: Settled cards preserve the decision and requester notices follow thread order. A decision that precedes card registration is settled immediately after registration. Displayed requester identity comes from a validated resume chain and does not alter authorization.

adrs.title: The turn receipt is an install choice
adrs.summary: The installation selects all actions, failed actions, or no receipt in a terminal reply.

adrs.title: Every mean tester probe only reads or asks
adrs.summary: The mean tester example bundle directs probes to read or ask on every installation, including test installations. This bundle policy does not establish that every probe uses per turn read only enforcement.

adrs.title: A signed hook may complete a preposted reply
adrs.summary: A signed hook may request completion of a preposted reply under its authenticated reply context.

adrs.title: Settled stream entries are trimmed; receipts live in Postgres; backlog is counted, not rated
adrs.summary: The worker implements supervised settled-entry trimming. This Draft also proposes Postgres delivery receipts and counted backlog; the observed retention implementation does not establish those remaining parts or authorize the whole proposal.

adrs.title: A factory ticket declares its base branch and keeps it
adrs.summary: Each factory ticket selects a validated base branch and retains it through its work item and publication lifecycle. The selected branch remains authoritative when its tip moves. The approved commit stays immutable while a verified first publication records its actual parent on that branch history; malformed or partial persisted authority refuses repository-default substitution.

adrs.title: The factory polls GitHub for its work, and the platform reads the issue
adrs.summary: Factory polling and optional webhooks share admission authority. Durable cursors and replica locking bound polling, and a platform scoped read supplies issue content without sandbox GitHub credentials.

adrs.title: The sandbox memory credential is scoped to its own channel
adrs.summary: The API confines memory to the current channel, requires a live turn credential for fact writes and records authors server side.

adrs.title: Deployed agents see only their bundle's skills
adrs.summary: The deployed harness exposes only bundle skills while keeping the Skill tool and approval hook.

adrs.title: Automated hook sources cannot widen their tool access
adrs.summary: Accepts mandatory source-scoped read-only authority and fail-closed admission. Durable source policy, operation history and ordinary-path fencing exist, while the complete protected delivery and qualified runtime path remain unestablished. ADR 0203 partially supersedes the premise that an automated source changes no system for prequalified platform execution while preserving the read-only model-turn source-policy invariants; the complete remediation path remains planned.

adrs.title: Protected hooks use a separately authorized delivery lane
adrs.summary: Selects a private protected broker and independently provisioned consumers. Authority records, source fencing, authenticated broker metadata, role ACLs and atomic admission/recovery primitives exist; complete provisioning, worker consumption, artifact qualification and delivery remain planned.

adrs.title: The model sees the platform sender
adrs.summary: The model sees the platform sender. See the pinned decision and implementation evidence.

adrs.title: Cluster up reads a missing RuntimeClass before install
adrs.summary: Direct cluster up reads the rendered RuntimeClass before install. NotFound inference and Forbidden admission recovery remain distinct. ADRs 0218 and 0221 extend inference to a present class with no matching node, including eligible fake-model auto installs.

adrs.title: The plugin-format contract is the frozen schema plus a parity gate
adrs.summary: The plugin-format contract is the frozen schema plus a parity gate. See the pinned decision and implementation evidence.

adrs.title: A version-only delta reuses its parent's checks
adrs.summary: The release authorizer may use the nearest fully green first-parent ancestor within ten steps only while its aggregate delta is version-only. The latest orderable attempt of each required check governs: a later successful attempt supersedes an earlier failure, while a current failure or skip still refuses. Missing timestamps force conservative evaluation of all attempts. ADR 0247 amends that tag gate. A parent whose git tree equals the tagged commit, including a merge's second parent, can supply proof before the version-only walk when its required checks are current and green. Registering only this release's schema window, equal to the ancestor's candidate, stays inside the version-only walk. A different tree does not qualify, and VERSION_ONLY_PATHS is unchanged.

adrs.title: Combined preparation PR checks can prove an unchanged release merge
adrs.summary: Proposes accepting the exact full-green combined preparation head only for an up-to-date merge with an empty or version-only merge delta. This Draft is not implemented or release authority. ADR 0247 separately accepts a tree-identical parent, so an up-to-date preparation merge whose tree equals its checked head can authorize from that head. A merge whose tree differs still waits for its own required checks.

adrs.title: The factory reaches code hosts and trackers through two ports
adrs.summary: The factory reaches code hosts and trackers through two ports. See the pinned decision and implementation evidence.

adrs.title: Identity links live in provider identity namespaces
adrs.summary: Provider namespaces, tenant-scoped identity links and ordered Slack principal resolution are implemented. Resolution uses exact active links, checks principal status and refuses unsupported providers. Accepted ADR 0220 plans IdP directory and one-time connect creation flows without administrator-made mappings; those flows and agent-wide team enforcement remain unbuilt.

adrs.title: Agents read and edit canvases shared into their bound channels
adrs.summary: Agents read and edit canvases shared into their bound channels. See the pinned decision and implementation evidence.

adrs.title: Provider field mappings live with their realization
adrs.summary: Provider field mappings live with their realization. See the pinned decision and implementation evidence.

adrs.title: A test installation admits a listed bot's actions and approval replies
adrs.summary: A test installation admits a listed bot's actions and approval replies. See the pinned decision and implementation evidence.

adrs.title: Automated remediation is a pre-qualified action the platform executes and verifies
adrs.summary: Administrator-bound prequalified platform execution and verification are accepted. Actions outside policy require approval, and undo of a policy-executed remediation is approval-gated. Complete qualified execution and the connector-owned restore executor remain planned. ADR 0231 supersedes only bind and arm authority with an independent API-only key; full qualified installation evidence remains required.

adrs.title: The factory checks its environment before it admits a ticket
adrs.summary: The factory checks its environment before it admits a ticket. See the pinned decision and implementation evidence.

adrs.title: An attachment belongs to its thread, and every boot rebuilds the thread's files
adrs.summary: An attachment belongs to its thread, and every boot rebuilds the thread's files. See the pinned decision and implementation evidence.

adrs.title: A factory run lost with its worker is re-admitted as a new attempt
adrs.summary: An owner-lost factory request settles before a new attempt is admitted on the same WorkItem, bounded to three consecutive owner losses. Status cards show RETRYING only when a successor was admitted; other failed and expired requests show NEEDS HUMAN. Acquired but unstarted requests renew their short lease every twenty seconds. Only not_started deferrals count toward the default five-attempt start cap; capacity and thread-busy waits do not. Started factory CI and approval continuations wait for sandbox capacity within their existing delivery and execution deadlines without charging runner retries.

adrs.title: A delivery owner rides through an ownership store outage shorter than its lease
adrs.summary: Delivery and consumer liveness renewals tolerate transport errors only until the last confirmed send plus TTL minus one heartbeat interval. A refused renewal loses authority immediately. Side-effect markers retry before applying the frame, and terminal settlement remains fenced. Runs and evals share this ownership rule.

adrs.title: A factory PR opened after its request was cancelled is adopted by the next run
adrs.summary: Accepted orphaned PR adoption and explicit refusal naming are planned. The current precheck still refuses an absent WorkItem lineage link; this release does not claim adoption is shipped.

adrs.title: Pause authority after a drain is a lease held by a live upgrade step
adrs.summary: A clean drain now hands off a 300 second lease. Attest renews only existing same-revision authority, schema-migrate renews throughout readiness and migration, and the last pre-upgrade hold hook extends that authority to the configured roll hold. Independent mail persistence and pre-upgrade gVisor checks run before drain. Missing or foreign authority refuses the upgrade without recreating a marker. Failure after the hold can still pause claims for the remaining roll hold; extend-only renewal never shortens a longer lease.

adrs.title: A bundle may declare a secret optional
adrs.summary: A bundle may declare a secret optional. See the pinned decision and implementation evidence.

adrs.title: A factory run that loses its sandbox is re-admitted like one that loses its worker
adrs.summary: Proposes a bounded factory successor after confirmed sandbox loss, sharing the owner-loss cap and adding static and action-ledger replay restrictions. It authorizes no implementation; sandbox loss after side effects still escalates under the current kernel.

adrs.title: A work item owner rides through a store outage and stops its turn when it cannot
adrs.summary: Would extend the delivery-lease outage ride-through to the SQL runtime heartbeat of started factory requests, and stop the turn when ownership cannot be confirmed.

adrs.title: One factory agent serves every GitHub repository bound to it
adrs.summary: One factory agent serves every GitHub repository bound to it. See the pinned decision and implementation evidence.

adrs.title: Each tracker surface starts factory work under its own trigger label
adrs.summary: Each tracker surface starts factory work under its own trigger label. See the pinned decision and implementation evidence.

adrs.title: A factory repository binding selects its own runner image, built from a tool catalog
adrs.summary: A factory repository binding selects its own runner image, built from a tool catalog. See the pinned decision and implementation evidence.

adrs.title: A factory run that opts into Docker gets its own daemon outside the sandbox
adrs.summary: A factory run that opts into Docker gets its own daemon outside the sandbox. The chart renders the daemon boundary, worker RBAC including pods/portforward for the ping, and a strict worker daemon configuration; per-run daemon lifecycle and certificate issuance are not implemented at this commit.

adrs.title: Cluster up infers gVisor off when the RuntimeClass matches no node
adrs.summary: Direct cluster up infers gVisor off from a readable empty RuntimeClass node-selector result. Explicit auto refuses; require retains the preflight. FailedScheduling diagnosis omits raw Event messages. ADR 0221 extends the lookup to eligible fake-model auto installs.

adrs.title: A deploy binds an agent's runner image at runtime, outside the Helm release
adrs.summary: A deploy binds an agent's runner image at runtime, outside the Helm release. See the pinned decision and implementation evidence.

adrs.title: One identity provider decides who may invoke and approve, on every channel
adrs.summary: Accepted 2026-10-14 through #4513. The tenant's IdP supplies read-only people, groups, account status and known channel accounts. Known accounts need no user action; unknown chat accounts connect once through IdP sign-in, with no administrator-made mappings. Separate agent-wide invocation and approver teams apply across channels, while existing lists may only narrow a team. Complete versioned membership snapshots retain the last known membership during sync outages and report sync health; independent versioned IdP status changes refuse inactive people. Scoped directory ingestion, one-time connect, agent access policies and invocation and approver team enforcement are implemented; Curie ships no IdP connector, and governed-domain email links remain planned. Partially supersedes ADR 0177 amendment A1 to A3 only for agents with an approver team; card location and existing behavior for a role without a team remain unchanged.

adrs.title: Cluster up reads the gVisor RuntimeClass for a fake-model install
adrs.summary: A second real-model render identifies eligible fake-model auto installs for RuntimeClass lookup. A readable empty node-selector result can infer off; unavailable evidence preserves the original plan. Prepared apply and dry runs remain excluded.

adrs.title: Coworker bundles own workflow policy and Curie enforces execution
adrs.summary: A coworker bundle owns its input contract, semantic interpretation and workflow policy as a versioned, digest-bound deployment artifact; Curie owns identity, tracker and code host adapters, authoritative facts, readiness and completion-evidence enforcement. The factory becomes a coworker using these mechanisms rather than hardcoded platform policy. Partially amends ADR 0199. No policy artifact reader or enforcement path exists at this commit.

adrs.title: Protected runtime commissioning precedes installation acceptance
adrs.summary: Protected runtime commissioning precedes installation acceptance. ADR 0236 commissioning components, Qualification and Readiness writers and the acceptance record writer now exist; no shipped path runs a complete campaign.

adrs.title: Turn action receipts are opt-in
adrs.summary: The worker turn receipt mode defaults to off. Operators may still select all or failures; unknown values refuse startup or chart validation. Completed actions remain recorded through the action API and side-effect markers still prevent unsafe retries.

adrs.title: Persist terminal answers before channel delivery
adrs.summary: A successful turn stores its final ReplyUpdate, stable delivery identity and approval-resume flag in the completion record before channel delivery. Redelivery and the completion sweeper replay the stored answer, never the model. Answer-bearing records use a versioned hash and pending index that older workers never sample. Slack partitions a long answer into sequential keyed continuation messages instead of truncating it.

adrs.title: Opt-in final-answer publication validation
adrs.summary: A bundle may declare a finalAnswer validation tool in curie.bundle.json, optionally scoped by trigger tools. A constrained turn publishes only text that exactly equals a correlated, digest-checked validation result, carried as ACI Final.text_mode verbatim (ACI 0.5.23) and reply wire 1.2. Callers negotiate exact output with X-Curie-Final-Answer; missing or mismatched validation becomes a classified failure. The executor endpoint cannot advertise support. Slack verbatim rendering is now one rich text section with literal links per partition (ADR 0250). The exact text requirement is unchanged.

adrs.title: Mail services plug into one email adapter, which owns approvals by email
adrs.summary: The email path has three layers: channel port, one neutral email adapter, and a versioned MailProvider per mail service. The adapter keeps the channel protocol, delivery state, inbound gate, intake path and approvals by email; a provider lists, reads, replies, finds reply markers, maps failures to neutral kinds and reports a sender verdict. AgentMail is the built-in provider and still declares no sender verification, so it refuses every inbound message. A conformance kit gates out-of-tree providers.

adrs.title: A hosted connector may declare the Host the caller proxy presents upstream
adrs.summary: A hosted connector may declare a loopback proxy_upstream_host. It renders only into the caller proxy, which replaces Host on requests that passed every admission and grant check; refused and direct-Service requests are never rewritten. Amends ADR 0178 decision 5.

adrs.title: Cluster upgrade and rollback report outcomes from one lifecycle record checked against the cluster
adrs.summary: Proposes one durable lifecycle record per release shared by cluster upgrade and rollback, with per-phase transitions, take-over and resume records, and outcomes checked against observed cluster state before success is reported. Not implemented at this commit.

adrs.title: Remediation policy bind and arm need an authority the platform key cannot derive
adrs.summary: Bind and arm require a separate API-only authority key; attribution principals cannot replace it.

adrs.title: A contract migration ships one release after the code stops using what it drops
adrs.summary: A CI gate refuses new destructive migrations while the previous stable application still reads the affected objects.

adrs.title: Factory publication recovery requires explicit operator adoption
adrs.summary: Rediscovery suppresses duplicate publication; reconstructing missing lineage requires future explicit operator adoption.

adrs.title: Factory-owned pull requests accept authorized feedback without a mention
adrs.summary: Authorized current feedback on an owned publication should request bounded revisions without a mention; coordinated provider and queue safeguards remain unimplemented.

adrs.title: Bitbucket Cloud publication discovery trusts tracker-authenticated receipts
adrs.summary: Proposes tracker-authenticated receipts for duplicate suppression without continuation authority. The shipped interim path refuses unverified open Cloud matches as unconfirmed.

adrs.title: The commissioning operator splits provisioner and control processes
adrs.summary: The protected commissioning operator runs as a provisioner process, which owns creation, the signing key and the acceptance decision, and a control process in the owned control Pod, which reobserves every guard fact per call and accepts only signed provisioner replies bound to that request. Provisioner core, journal, reservations, ACL observation, campaign guard, observation channel, local Cilium producer, standalone ingress and worker entries and Qualification and Readiness writers exist as separate compositions; no shipped command or chart runs a complete campaign yet.

adrs.title: Ordinary hook receipts preserve policy after stream retention
adrs.summary: Ordinary hook enqueue atomically retains a bounded receipt beside its permanent Valkey claim, preserving the original stream ID, conversation and selected tool policy after stream trimming. Faithful completed retries can return that receipt without the original queued turn. Mismatched, malformed or orphan receipt metadata refuses with 409. Legacy claims without receipt metadata still require the original queue entry.

adrs.title: A managed CNI installation qualifies through its own behavioral network producer
adrs.summary: A managed CNI installation qualifies only through a behavioral network producer of its own, with fail-closed pass, fail and unavailable verdicts. The managed CNI probe kit, case table and Kubernetes probe programs exist. BehavioralNetworkProducer is a Protocol implemented structurally by ProbeKit (managed-behavioral-v1) and LocalCiliumNetworkProducer (local-cilium-v1). No production composition root constructs either producer, and no shipped command runs a complete campaign.

adrs.title: Release kind proof reuses a complete CI run on the same tree
adrs.summary: Release kind proof reuses one completed successful ci.yaml run only when its head tree equals the tagged tree and every required concrete job, including all 19 canonical upgrade shards, succeeds within that run. Missing, skipped, conflicting or incomplete evidence refuses reuse. Otherwise one no-input tag dispatch is polled within a bounded deadline, with transient GET 5xx retries. The gate records the selected run URL and whether it reused or dispatched proof; release authorization remains a separate unchanged gate.

adrs.title: A tree-identical parent or a schema window registration reuses checks
adrs.summary: When the tagged commit's own required checks are absent or still running, and none of its current attempts concluded non-passing, release/authorize.py may reuse green required checks from a parent with the identical git tree, including a merge's second parent, before the version-only walk. Inside that walk, registering only this tag's schema window as the ancestor's candidate still counts as version identity. A different tree is never consulted, a current non-passing attempt still refuses, and VERSION_ONLY_PATHS is not broadened. Ancestry, tag class, the nightly gate and the PR selector are unchanged.

adrs.title: A factory run may take twelve hours
adrs.summary: The per-agent execution deadline ceiling, the worker delivery budget ceiling, and the runner request ceiling are 43200 seconds. The default deadline stays 1800 seconds, the shipped chart values stay 10800 seconds, the factory quickstart stays 10800 seconds, and the CI wait ceiling stays 10800 seconds. Migration 0140 enforces the new database ceiling and refuses downgrade while a longer deadline remains.

adrs.title: Verbatim Slack answers render as rich text sections with literal links
adrs.summary: A verbatim Slack answer is one rich text section of text and literal link elements per partition. The visible text reconstructs the approved answer exactly, ordinary replies are unchanged, and a msg_too_long refusal is resent as smaller keyed parts.

adrs.title: Claim-backed sandbox scratch is bounded by its storage request
adrs.summary: The decision record is still Draft. The chart already ships the opt-in: scratchVolume.type defaults to emptyDir, and ephemeral backs only workspace and the runner home with a claim-scoped volume bounded by its storage request. Other writable paths stay emptyDir with a positive sizeLimit.

adrs.title: Publication validates and pushes a Git object overlay
adrs.summary: Proposes replacing complete archive validation and checkout-based publication with verified source receipts, bounded explicit Git object reads, affected-path reconstruction and two bound validation manifests. Preserve prepared-base and repository authority, approval, path and dependency policy, moved-base first-publication proof and fenced lineage settlement. Forge failures refuse before approval with no archive fallback. This Draft authorizes no implementation; current publication still validates the private archive and applies the patch in a checkout.

investments.title: Close remaining channel interaction and the generic adapter kit
investments.why: Slack, Discord, and email prove ingress and HTTP reply, the built-in cluster-message relay proves a third ReplySink, and a scoped adapter principal now carries approval decisions without the platform key. A real second interactive adapter, Choice/Confirm outside Slack, and the generic third-party adapter kit remain unproved or unbuilt.
investments.unlock: Discord or email approvals through the scoped adapter principal, a re-evaluated Communication grade, and a kit only if a third-party channel needs it.

investments.title: Run a genuinely different harness through the ACI
investments.why: The outer contract is strong, but the current in-process path and bundle distribution wedge still hide the real replacement cost. ADR 0140 stops speculative selector work until a real second harness exists; the current product deliberately supports Claude only.
investments.unlock: Credible Codex/ADK/Strands support, truthful harness conformance, optional native checkpoints.

investments.title: Close the semantic eval and promotion gap
investments.why: The parity ladder is the product promise, but provenance quality and red-eval promotion still have reserved or validated-only clauses.
investments.unlock: Fatal cluster quality gates, meaningful source verification, stronger PR-to-production trust.

investments.title: Close declared webhook deployment gaps
investments.why: Seven bespoke trigger producers and a lost factory label reconciler converge on QueuedTurn rather than a unified trigger port. Cron schedules ship, while declared generic webhook deployment wiring remains absent.
investments.unlock: Bundle declared webhook installation, explicit delivery destinations, and operator admission that preserve each producer's existing authority and bounded queue delivery.

investments.title: Move credentials and enforceable egress out of the sandbox
investments.why: The current service-key path and accepted delegated-OAuth design expose the same unresolved security boundary: credentials, principal binding, and enforceable egress still span several owners.
investments.unlock: Stronger tenant isolation, explicit service versus delegated identity, per-person MCP authority, centralized credential policy, and auditable outbound access.

investments.title: Neutralize the observability read side
investments.why: OTLP is already a good write port; vendor attributes, route names, and read modules are the remaining concentrated leakage.
investments.unlock: A practical second trace backend without UI or API contract churn.

productAltitudes.label: Platform capability
productAltitudes.description: Capabilities that remove an adoption blocker: on premises operation, the channel surfaces, security, identity, and open source model choice. Every component that carries no altitude is read as platform. The capability overview groups workspace adaptors, authentication and authorization with directory synchronization, memory and context, and controls; these are capability categories rather than additional services or new support guarantees.

productAltitudes.label: Bot capability
productAltitudes.description: Bundles, evals, and operating patterns that ride the isolated runtime. They are reasons to buy rather than architecture peers of the worker or the runner.

productAltitudes.label: Deployed agent
productAltitudes.description: One agent as it exists in an install: an identity, a bundle, and a deployment. An agent may be authored anywhere; Curie gives it an identity and a channel.
